clue.text: Regularly, groovy musical works featured on peak broadcast

indicators.note: in this across clue, the other pieces are placed on (after) the peak piece

oft, an old word for often, is what regularly suggests here

explanation.surface: Fashionable music is said to have been played on some high-altitude transmission.
explanation.walkthrough: 'featured on' puts the peak piece first, with the rest after it. The answer was a long-running BBC television chart music show; HEP is dated slang.
explanation.definitionFit: The chart show was a weekly television programme, so it is an example of a broadcast.

clue.text: Restart training for dogs

clue.text: Singular form of "astro-thing" moving round globe

explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as a description: a meteor is one astronomical thing in motion around the planet.
explanation.definitionFit: A shooting star is a meteor, a single body streaking across the sky.

clue.text: Ill-tempered computer expert
